section.5: The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer

5.name_native: The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer

hadiths.text: Abu Huraira reported:We performed prostration along with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (as he recited these verses: )" When the heaven burst asunder" and" Read in the name of Thy Lord" (al-Qur'an, xcvi)
